climbing wall noun

* our formation

* (our own formation) pariēs ad scandendum

Our description: a wall for climbing (pariēs, parietis m., wall).

See also climbing hold, climbing route, climbing frame, climb.

Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.

L&S ansa documents handles and things taken hold of. The hold and route senses above are our semantic extensions. Examples are composed for conversation with the child; dictionary links document the component words, not these exact sentences or standardized modern climbing terminology.
